description: A Flutter source file defining a TV-optimized login screen with focus navigation, dialogs for editing username/password, and a login button that navigates to the home page. Implements focus traversal and remote-friendly input handling.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A stateful widget representing an Android TV style login screen with focusable input fields and a login button.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State implementation for LoginScreen, managing focus nodes, input states, and navigation logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes focus nodes and sets initial focus to username tile.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes focus nodes to free resources.

methods.name: _requestNext
methods.description: Requests focus to move to the next focus node.

methods.name: _requestPrev
methods.description: Requests focus to move to the previous focus node.

methods.name: _triggerLogin
methods.description: Handles login action by navigating to the /home route.

methods.name: _handleDpadTraversal
methods.description: Handles focus movement and selection via DPad keys, including Up, Down, and Enter/Select.

methods.name: _editValue
methods.description: Displays a dialog for editing a string value (username or password), supporting remote keyboard input.

methods.name: _passwordPreview
methods.description: Returns a masked preview string for the password.

methods.name: _focusableTile
methods.description: Builds a focusable ListTile for input fields with focus highlighting and activation callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the TV-friendly login UI with focus management, input fields, and login button.
